lesson.subtitle: Lesson 21 -- Florida, Three Times
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 21 -- Florida, Three Times
lesson.grammar_point: past simple of to be: was / were (affirmative, negative, questions and short answers)

listenings.text: Hi Ricardo, it's Linda. Welcome back to Miami! I know your flight was late. The airport was very crowded today, and the weather was terrible this morning. But now it is sunny. The car from the office is outside, at door five. The driver's name is Tony. See you at the office!

Hi, it's Paul. My first trip to Brazil was in 2012. I was in São Paulo for work, for two weeks. The meetings were long, and the traffic was terrible. But the people were very friendly, and the food was amazing. My favorite was the feijoada. And the weather? It wasn't cold. It was hot, with a lot of rain. Now I go to Brazil every year.

extra_audio.text: My first trip to Florida was a vacation. I was in Orlando with my family. The weather was very hot. The theme parks were crowded. But it was amazing.
